texts: In REPAIR-AMI the greatest gain in LVEF came in patients with a low baseline ejection fraction who received the cells after day 4: baseline LVEF 30 percent, cells given 6 days after infarction.
Bone marrow cells were infused into the infarct artery 3 to 7 days after successful reperfusion; at 4 months the ejection fraction had risen by about 2.5 points more than with placebo.
The benefit was concentrated in patients whose ejection fraction was at or below the median, about 49 percent, and in those treated more than 4 days after reperfusion.
In the picture, the weak bouncer at 30 gains the most when the bone seedlings are planted on day 6; seedlings planted on smoking ground wilt, and the strong bouncer at 55 hardly changes.
Memory hook: plant on day 6, beside the weakest bouncer.
